usage: 睇 is a commonly used verb meaning 'to look' or 'to watch'.
You can use 睇 before nouns to indicate looking at something, for example 睇書 (read/look at a book).
睇 can describe both casual looking and intentional watching, such as 睇電視 (watch TV).
睇 does not change form for tense; time words or context show when the action occurs.
睇 can also be used with objects like 睇報紙 (read the newspaper) or 睇螢幕 (look at the screen).
